rubric.note: Fixed: a north apse now exists, a stone-faced bay with a pointed arch, a gear oculus, the centre lancet and a two-step altar carrying the reward. All three lancets now sit in pointed walnut frames, so the spandrel gap is gone. A bronze gear-wheel chandelier hangs on the room axis. Still open: the ceiling is the same flat plank deck with two beams, with no vault, rib or height change over the apse, so the 12x12x6 m volume still reads as a box. The apse is a shallow rectangular stone slab with a pointed opening (hero shot x 548-727), not a recessed space. The guardian stands on open floor, with no dais (deferred under build decision D1).

Fixed: the axis now ends in a focal shrine. Aisle lines, the brass ring, two brazier pillars and the chandelier all lead the eye to the altar, and the reward sits on a stepped plinth with two candles. Still open: the guardian socket at z=-3 is flat floor inside a thin ring inlay, about one line-width at hero distance. Nothing raises, frames or encloses the fight itself. The altar is modest, about 1.4 m tall (collider max y 1.36). Read cold, the room is now a chapel with a shrine, but not yet a boss arena.

Lightmap density fell to 42.6 px/m mean and 36.0 px/m minimum, down from 45.3 and 38.1, and 36% below the study's 66.3 (accepted under D2). Brazier flames are still faceted pyramid shards. At the reward eye-point they read as pale peach crystals, RGB 192,135,95. Wall gears are rust-copper, not brass: engine RGB 64,25,10 (G/R 0.39) against polished brass #DEC16A (G/R 0.87), and the lightmap-only Blender render shows the same 64,27,6, so this is the albedo, not the runtime. The apse oculus gear reads grey steel, and the gilt bands read olive-flat. The centre-lancet wash is still open at the reward eye-point: luma 115 against 68 on the side lancets (previously 127,121,119 against 88,74,75). Pillar stone, wallpaper damask and the floor pattern are crisp and in kit language.

Fixed: the braziers now bake real pools. The floor at the brazier foot has luma 51 against open floor at 38-43 in the hero shot, and 61 against 39 from the brazier camera (+56%), with a warm glow column up each pillar (luma 72-78 against 37-39 above). Stained-glass patches land on the floor. Corners are warm dark (45,11,5), not black. Still open: flame colour. R-B is 95 in engine against 142 for candle amber, up from 69. The bake and lightmap-only engine frames have 151-161, so the runtime full-material path desaturates the flames. New: the room is much darker than the study, with mean frame luma 35.9 against 57.7 and wallpaper luma 18 against 62. The walls fall to maroon-black outside the pools, and there is no wall-mounted light source.

rubric.criterion: readability and comfort at seated VR distance
rubric.note: The open floor and the single strong axis to the altar make the guardian and reward positions obvious, and the large scale is comfortable seated. Deductions: the flame shards sit at about eye height beside the reward eye-point as bright pale wedges (luma 144). The very dark side walls (luma 18) flatten the room's width at a glance.

topFixes: Fix the two runtime regressions that the bake does not have. First, flames: the bake and lightmap-only frames have R-B 151-161, the full engine frame 95, so keep the emissive flame and glass out of the AgX/probe path that desaturates them, and replace the faceted pyramid flames with soft flame cards or tapered tongues. Second, the centre lancet: bake luma 72, level with the sides at 70-72, but 89 against 73 in the engine hero shot and 115 against 68 at the reward eye. Remove the probe or specular wash, likely including the bright gilt mullion at luma 129.

Make the brass read as brass. Bring the wall gears (albedo about 64,27,6, G/R 0.39), the apse oculus gear (grey) and the gilt bands (olive-flat) to the polished-brass palette #DEC16A, using a metallic or probe highlight as the art bible prescribes for polished brass.

Turn the shrine into an arena and lift the value. Raise a stepped dais under the guardian socket (this needs the src/content/rooms.ts socket change that D1 left to Paul). Add a vault or ribbed arches over the apse instead of the flat plank deck. Add baked wall sconces or a second light ring so the side walls rise from luma 18 toward the study's 60 range while the brazier pools stay dominant.
independentScore.method: Judged the engine shots first: all six docs/verification/p5-rooms-guardian-vault-*.jpg, viewed in full, with Pillow crops zoomed 2-4x of the flames, altar, apse, lancets, chandelier, wall gears and pillar caps. Region means were measured as sRGB RGB and Rec.709 luma (0-255), plus R-B warmth. Compared against the study kit's engine frame p5-int-study.jpg and the study review sheet and density (66.28 px/m mean). Used the Blender renders (hero.lightmapped.png, hero.reference-diffuse.png) and the engine lightmap-only frame (engine.hero.diffuse.png) at identical pixel regions to separate bake from runtime. Flame whitening and centre-lancet wash appear only in the full-material engine frame, so they are runtime. Rust-coloured wall gears and darkness appear in the bake too, so they are source and lighting. The score weights the engine frames. Read the art bible, report.json (density, bake), engine-compare.json (frame ratio 0.916, RMSE 0.0376), uv1-report.json (coverage 0.373, 0 px overlap, min gap 15 px) and provenance.json (previous independentScore, build decisions D1-D6). Side finding, not scored: provenance.json stagingFiles hashes for engine-compare.json (4f9d6272...) and uv1-report.json (0592795e...) do not match the files on disk (82610923..., 326fa8f8...). The glb, lightmap PNG and KTX2, and manifest hashes match.

decisions.decision: Apse with a stepped altar behind the reward socket instead of a dais; greybox sockets unchanged (a dais needs src/content/rooms.ts to raise them, Paul's call).
Accept the vault's ~43 px/m lightmap mean (built 42.63) without zone weighting; one 2048 map cannot reach 65 px/m at uniform density.
The dielectric `gilt` CONST slot (a departure from the shared metallic PBR brass sets) is allowed for this build.
Keep the deeper fire colour: P5-T2 flames emit (1.0, 0.33, 0.06), unlike the hall and study candle flame.

notes: Coals and P5-T2 fire flames carry a dark albedo with strong emission (colour x 0.25, Blender strength and runtime emissiveIntensity x 4: coals 12.0 / 5.6, flame 24.0 / 5.6), so the emitted light is unchanged and the lightmap term on them is a quarter. Measured on the first 2026-11-17 bake: engine firebox R-B 101 -> 108, pit 112 -> 112.
